## Local OCR

- Windows and macOS downloads include Tesseract OCR and English language data.
  No separate Tesseract installation is needed for these builds.
- OCR runs locally. Review extracted text and BOM quantities against the drawing;
  complex or low-resolution drawings may still require clarification.

## BOM export

- Fixed a Windows CSV encoding mismatch that could prevent BOM generation when
  drawing text contains characters such as the degree symbol.

## Help and AI settings

- Added a Help window with workflow examples and troubleshooting guidance.
- AI settings explain the required API key, vision model and endpoint, and link
  to the selected provider's setup and model pages.
- AI remains optional; when enabled, drawing and scope data are sent to the
  selected provider. API billing may be separate from a web chat subscription.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.23...v0.1.24
